tea.name: Kanoyama · Tezumi
tea.notes: Okumidori matcha made by Azuma Chaen. Nutty and cocoa-like; grown in Wazuka. One of the two teas in the Classic Matcha Bundle.
preparation: Sift the measured matcha into a chawan.
Add the measured water at the listed temperature; whisk briskly back and forth for about 20 seconds.
Drink promptly. Matcha is whisked once, not reinfused.
tea.sourceNote: Vendor recipe: Tezumi specifies 2 g / 70 mL at 70°C, whisked about 20 seconds. Smaller preset is proportional. Soft water is a Barista starting choice. House water recommendation: Soft. This maps to your concentrate recipes, not a vendor water specification; adjust to taste.

drinks.name: Karak Chai · elaichi co.

ingredients.name: Karak Chai Blend (dry volume; 15 mL ≈ 1 tbsp)

drinks.notes: Made by elaichi co.; sold by Fellow. Organic CTC Assam tea from Chota Tingrai Farm and cardamom from Chemparathy Estate. Whole-milk stovetop version. Ingredient total is only the app's scaling reference, not final beverage yield; evaporation and strained solids reduce yield. For more than two servings, follow the vendor batch guide: cap added water at one cup. Do not use a teapot on the stove.
drinks.sourceNote: Adapted metric starting point from the vendor's one-cup recipe: 1 cup milk, 1/2 cup water, 1 tbsp blend, 1.5 tsp sugar. Milk/water/sugar are rounded kitchen weight adaptations, not vendor gram measurements. Blend stays a volume measure because its gram weight is unverified. The 100°C milk target denotes stovetop boiling, not steam-wand milk preparation. House water recommendation: Robust. This maps to your concentrate recipes, not a vendor water specification; adjust to taste.
preparation: Use a saucepan with plenty of room for the milk to rise. The listed amounts make roughly one serving; final yield varies.
Bring the measured whole milk and water to a gentle boil together, watching the pan.
Add the measured chai blend and sugar. Reduce the heat and simmer gently for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Ladle a little chai up and gently back into the pan a few times without splashing. Remove from heat, strain and serve.
